limitations: Target-structure inference only; coupling reagent, activation state, and protecting-group sequence are not specified.
Free secondary alcohols and the oxetane-bearing taxane core create chemoselectivity and stability risks.
Does not solve construction or stereochemical validation of the taxane skeleton.
Late-stage proposal only; it does not prove upstream access to baccatin III or the Ojima lactam.
The beta-lactam precursor stereochemical SMILES should be checked against the exact enantiomer and protecting-group variant used in the cited procedure before experimental use.
Conditions are summarized at route-family level, not an executable protocol.
The full late-stage enzymatic sequence to paclitaxel is not presented here as a solved preparative route.
The exact side-chain hydroxylase step and substrate order need independent confirmation for route design.
CoA thioesters, enzyme expression, cofactor recycling, and taxane solubility are likely major constraints.
